# GitHub Copilot instructions — BrightScale Tracker

This repository has a living cross-LLM project handoff. **Before coding**, read:
- [Root agent instructions](../AGENTS.md)
- [Continuity protocol](../docs/CONTINUITY_PROTOCOL.md)
- [Canonical handoff, decisions 1–39](../docs/SMART_REMODELING_HANDOFF_2026-10-26.md)

Product decisions **1–39 are confirmed and the interview is closed** by explicit owner request. Do not propose decision #40; prioritize a field-testable MVP. Decision #39 requires linked audit correction records and PM-restricted display of sensitive/incorrect evidence, subject to lawful deletion and retention. Work toward a field-testable MVP; do not claim proposed features are implemented. Preserve PM approvals, financial privacy and independent client/sub contracts, immutable project baseline and separate Change Orders. Supabase `public` and `private` schemas are OUT OF SCOPE. For material changes, update the existing canonical handoff with commit/PR links, evidence, tests, blockers and next action.
